title: Every push and pull request into the default branch runs the RCF gate suite as a required check
asA: operator merging changes to the default branch of an rcf-lite project
iWant: the RCF gate suite to run automatically on every push to the default branch and every pull request into it, and its outcome to be the merge criterion
soThat: no change lands on the default branch without the chain and its coverage having been verified against the tree at the head commit

acceptanceCriteria.description: The CI provider's job for the pipeline is triggered by a push to the default branch and by every pull request opened, synchronised, or reopened against the default branch. The trigger configuration is committed under source control, not set through a provider UI.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the project's CI configuration and repository state at the head commit
acceptanceCriteria.when: a push lands on the default branch or a pull request is opened, synchronised, or reopened against the default branch
acceptanceCriteria.then: the aggregate pipeline report at the configured stable path (default `.rcf/reports/ci/pipeline.json`) is written by the resulting CI job, and its `trigger` field records the event kind

acceptanceCriteria.description: The pull-request merge policy blocks a merge whose most recent pipeline run did not exit zero. The block is enforced by the repository's branch protection or equivalent policy configured for the default branch.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a pull request whose most recent pipeline run's aggregate report records `verdict: failed`
acceptanceCriteria.when: the operator or an automated merge tool attempts to merge the pull request through the standard merge path
acceptanceCriteria.then: the merge is refused by the platform's branch-protection surface, and the refusal reason references the failed required check that corresponds to the pipeline job
